# WiseGeek

> WiseGeek is an informational resource providing accessible explanations and guidance across diverse topics, supported by transparent affiliate marketing and advertising partnerships.

WiseGeek maintains editorial integrity through published guidelines and transparent business practices. The site is based in San Francisco and partners with numerous affiliate programs including Amazon Associates, AppSumo, and other educational and lifestyle brands.

## Key Topics

- Editorial Guidelines
- Content Standards
- Affiliate Marketing
- Advertising
- Revenue Model
- Business Model
- Transparency
- Partnerships
- Amazon Associates
- Adsense
- Monetization
- San Francisco
- Feedback
- Contact Information

## Editorial Standards & Transparency

- [wiseGEEK Editorial Guidelines: Transparency, Quality, Trust](https://www.wisegeek.net/editorial-guidelines.htm): WiseGeek's editorial standards for accuracy, integrity, and content quality
- [How WiseGeek Makes Money: Advertising, Affiliates & More](https://www.wisegeek.net/how-we-make-money.htm): WiseGeek's revenue model: affiliate marketing, Adsense, Amazon Associates

## Legal & Privacy

- [WiseGeek's Privacy Policy | How We Protect Your Information](https://www.wisegeek.net/what-is-the-privacy-policy.htm): WiseGeek privacy policy on data collection, cookies, and information protection
